note: Rated renders: scratchpad/w14 (m01-m19) and w14q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 2c1eb9d (includes 74e228b). Compared pixel by pixel with w13/w13q: the largest changes are in m16 (15 % of pixels), m04 (13 %), m11, m03, m09, m10 and m01. The q01, q11 and q19 cameras are different from w13 (q01 is now the door-1 aisle between two wood walls, q11 a front view of the bar from the J aisle, q19 a wide view of the door-5 galley), so those three views are rated afresh rather than compared. Lighting is noted but not scored: the white wash on the upper galley compartments (m01, m09, m12, q19) and the bright ceiling panel in q19. Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 by luminance over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Script: scratchpad/raterA14/samp.py. Side-by-side w13-over-w14 images: scratchpad/raterA14/cmp_*.png.

Pane (500,210,680,290) #3b3335 against lalf_134 (920,320,1000,450) #473a3c and omaat_room_32 #292726, so it is in range and no longer a hole. Remaining: the housing top is at y 122 against the monitor top at y 110 (about 4 cm low), and the tag sits on the fascia above the housing (y 95-120) instead of inside the housing head as in lalf_134 and omaat_room_32. The round knob is replaced by a small dark rectangular latch that nearly vanishes in m16. See the low issue.

issues.detail: Bar tumblers read as lidded cans (m05, m06)

issues.detail: Ash-wall flap frames flat and square (m04)
issues.problem: The frames are flat 2D strips with square corners and a single red pill latch. lalf_133 shows rounded-corner, bevelled aluminium frames with a two-tab red latch on a silver catch.
issues.fix: Frame corners gRBox radius about 0.03 with a 1 cm bevel (the same tri cost as a rounded rect); latch as two small red tabs on a 6 cm silver plate.

issues.detail: Door-1 dark wood streak smear and hue (q01, m19)
issues.problem: At grazing angles the wood layer aliases into radial streaks that look like motion blur, and the hue is cool mauve against the warm dark-brown wood of the F cabin.
issues.evidence: q01 (50,50,330,500) #3f3637 (red minus blue 8), std 13; omaatF_2 dark wood (1040,600,1100,800) #2b2117 (red minus blue 20).
issues.fix: Monument dark-wood material toward '#3a2e27' (warmer); reduce the grain gain or the UV frequency along the grain on the large door-1 side walls (the aliasing may be a texture-filtering matter for the lighting/integration owner).
